channel.title: Los Angeles Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: TSA to continue PreCheck service during partial government shutdown
item.description: The Transportation Security Administration said Sunday that its PreCheck program would remain operational, hours after announcing it was being suspended because of the partial government shutdown.

item.title: California Democrats unite against Trump, differ on vision for state's future
item.description: While united against a common political enemy in the White House, the California Democratic Party remains deeply divided over how to address the state’s affordability crisis and who is best suited to lead the state in this turbulent era of President Trump.

item.title: Former 'American Idol' contestant charged with murder, staging crime scene in wife's slaying in Ohio
item.description: Authorities in Ohio have arrested a former contestant on “American Idol” and charged him with shooting and killing his wife and staging the crime scene to mislead investigators.

item.title: With Winter Olympics over, L.A. is officially on the clock for 2028 Summer Games
item.description: In just over two years, the United States will host the country’s first Summer Games since 1996, welcoming an Olympic movement that is surging in popularity but unsteady in a changing world.

item.title: Inside the room at the Alan Cumming-hosted BAFTA Awards, plus a full list of winners
item.description: An upset for leading actor jolted excitement into the proceedings, proving a highlight of a smoothly run ceremony, which was televised on the BBC with cuts.

item.title: During statue unveiling, Pat Riley reminds the disjointed Lakers of keys to winning
item.description: On the day his statue was unveiled outside Crypto.com Arena, Showtime era coach Pat Riley urged the Lakers to fight to create legacies worth chasing.

item.title: Mexican army kills 'El Mencho,' Mexico's most-wanted drug kingpin
item.description: The Mexican army has killed the leader of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel in a military operation.

item.title: 'That man is a monster': California serial child molester granted parole. Victims are outraged
item.description: A Sacramento man who prosecutors said used candy and toys to lure children into his car and then molest them was granted elderly parole. Several of his victims and the woman who prosecuted the case are horrified that he may soon be released.

item.title: Thousands gather for Chinatown parade to celebrate Lunar New Year and Los Angeles
item.description: The 2026 Golden Dragon Parade drew thousands of people to L.A.'s Chinatown to celebrate Lunar New Year and the Year of the Fire Horse.

item.title: Two more skiers die in the Lake Tahoe area
item.description: Two more deaths added to the toll of a week that included the most deadly avalanche in modern California history. These unrelated deaths were at the Heavenly resort.
